target_customer: Insurance underwriting and claims teams and law firms
problem: Unstructured medical records take long to read; RiskAngle summarizes them for underwriting, claims and case preparation.

founders.name: Bill Chen
education: Columbia University, BA computer science (YC page)

founders.name: William Hu
prior_employers: Anthropic (member of technical staff, from 2025-09 per directory)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC founders profile says RiskAngle was acquired in 2025.

competitors.name: DigitalOwl
competitors.what: Reads and summarizes medical records into underwriting abstracts for insurers and law firms
competitors.traction_then: Insight Partners led its Series A in January 2022

competitors.name: Wisedocs
competitors.what: Medical record review, indexing and AI summaries for insurance claims
competitors.traction_then: About 50 customers after doubling its base in 2023; AI summaries launched June 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM summarization of records with OCR and structuring is mostly integration work by 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals already sold the same product and no proprietary data is described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded rivals were already selling the same wedge before the batch; the buyer of RiskAngle is not named in sources.

market_need_then: Insurers and law firms review large unstructured record sets; rivals raised Series A rounds in 2022 and 2024, which shows spend.

brand_strength.rationale: No source describes the logo, visual style or voice, so the brand cannot be rated above forgettable.

outcome_analysis: RiskAngle was a two founder San Francisco team selling AI medical record summaries to insurers and law firms, in YC Summer 2024. A YC founder profile says it was acquired in 2025, and William Hu then joined Anthropic in September 2025, but no source names the buyer, price or terms. Competition from DigitalOwl and Wisedocs was well funded before the batch. The directory shows Inactive consistent with an acquisition.
notes: Company site fetch returned only the title. Round rests on VCBacked alone (Crunchbase shows a similar pre-seed total). Acquirer is not public in sources opened; searches did not confirm an Anthropic deal and none is claimed. Sources conflict on whether the YC page lists the acquisition.
